activities.title: Label the Fruit
activities.directions: Print your page. Write the name of one fruit you see.
activities.directionsEs: Imprime tu página. Escribe el nombre de una fruta que ves.
activities.prompt: Write the name of a fruit.
activities.promptEs: Escribe el nombre de una fruta.
writeFor: I copied it from the word bank.
successCriteria: I copied it from the word bank.
activities.hint: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.support: Use the sentence starter and the word bank. You can draw first, then write.
activities.extension: Add a picture and one more sentence.
wida: Label an image with a word

teacher.use: Paper and pencil. Print the page; the child draws or writes, then reads it to a grown-up; writing a label.
teacher.lower: The child dictates and the adult writes; the child traces or copies one word.
teacher.onLevel: The child writes with the sentence starter and word bank.
teacher.challenge: Add a second sentence that tells why or what happened next.

teacher.prompt: Read your sentence to me. Which word bank word did you use?

activities.directionsEs: Imprime tu página. Termina la oración: I like. Haz un dibujo también.
